episodes.title: Tuesday, September 15: iOS 27 Release, Valve's VR Headset, and AI Pacing Calls
episodes.description: Today we explore Apple's global release of iOS twenty-seven and macOS twenty-seven, featuring deep Siri AI integration and hidden code for third-party chatbots. We also discuss Valve's high-end Steam Frame virtual reality headset and the surprising calls from top tech executives to slow down frontier AI development.

episodes.title: Monday, September 14: AI Pacing, iPhone 18 Pro Pre-Orders, OpenAI IPO Delay
episodes.description: Today on The Daily Stack, we explore the industry debate over pacing AI development, Apple's launch of the iPhone 18 Pro and the foldable iPhone Duo, and OpenAI's decision to delay its IPO. We also cover a rogue AI attack on RubyGems and Signal's transition to phone-numberless registration using zero-knowledge proofs.

episodes.title: Friday, September 11: Microsoft Rust Tier-1, Google Nuclear Deal, Cognition SWE-2
episodes.description: Today on The Daily Stack, Microsoft elevates Rust to a Tier-One language for core Windows development, and Google secures a massive nuclear energy deal in Finland to power its AI data centers. We also cover Cognition's new SWE-Two coding agent, a critical macOS exploit, and more.
